brand: charcoal and sage; no purple, neon, emoji or gold
question: Is the 046 replay difference caused by the wall-clock per-call cap rather than by the wrapper? Does a new deterministic-cap interface brute.certify/16d (each call capped by a fixed conflict count rather than wall time) make the A16 declared-N identifier byte-reproducible and faithful? And does it stay sound, and decide cases, on fresh 16-state worlds and a first set of fresh 20-state worlds?

hypotheses.H1: cap nondeterminism, not wrapper infidelity: when frozen A16_N replays its own sealed traces, its labels change only on cases with at least one capped call; API16 and A16_N agree on every replay where neither side hits the cap
hypotheses.H2: with a fixed per-call conflict cap, two independent passes of certify/16d over the same cases give byte-identical records (labels, models, words, capped counts)
hypotheses.H3: certify/16d is faithful: driving it observation by observation over its own recorded traces reproduces every record exactly, and on sealed 045/046 traces with no capped call it gives the same label, n_min and model as the sealed record
hypotheses.H4: on fresh scale16 worlds certify/16d issues no WRONG certificate and decides at least as many cases as A16_N decided in 046 (7/12)
hypotheses.H5: scale-20 (exploratory): at family_bound 20 and the same per-case budget, certify/16d stays sound (WRONG 0) on fresh 20-state worlds; the decided count is reported, not predicted

design.api: new file brute/api/certify16d.py (additive; certify16.py, certify14.py and every frozen file untouched, imported only): Certifier16D(initial, num_actions, family_bound<=20, search='a16d', conflict_cap=C, budget_conflicts=B) with the certify/16 methods (current, observe, propose, result, close) and a one-shot certify16d(...). The A16 loop is unchanged; only the cap changes: each SAT call stops after C conflicts (a fixed number, checked chunk by chunk with no clock), and the case budget is B total conflicts. A wall-clock safety stop (30 s per call, 600 s per case) is kept only as a host guard. If it fires, the record is flagged 'wall_guard' and counts against GDET. Returns {'api': 'brute.certify/16d', 'label', 'model', 'n_min', 'family_bound', 'calls', 'conflicts', 'capped', 'wall_guard'}. Host-agnostic as in 046
design.cap_rule: C and B are fixed BEFORE the source freeze by a declared rule. C = the median number of conflicts the frozen A16_N solver completes in 9.0 s on the pre-freeze smoke range (11570001-11570006 only, never gated), rounded down to a multiple of the chunk size. B = 240/9 x C. Both values are ledgered with the smoke result. No sealed or held-out data is used to choose them
design.scale20: new world family scale20 (20-state reachable minimal machines, 3 actions, 2 output bits, generated exactly as scale16 with n=20). It lives in a new generator file. The frozen generators are untouched. Declared bound N=20. A16_MAX_BOUND in certify16 is not changed; certify16d has its own bound of 20

arms.API16D: certify/16d driven only through its public interface (conflict cap C, budget B, K=128, declared N=16 on scale16/control and N=20 on scale20)
arms.API16D_b: the same arm run as a second independent pass in a separate process with a different job order (determinism check only)
arms.A16_N: frozen brute/scalesearch16 study arm, 046 settings (wall cap 9.0 s, 240 s), on fresh scale16 and control only (reference)
arms.API16: frozen certify/16 (046 wall cap), used in the part-a replays only

parts.a_diagnose: replays, reported and classified rather than gated, except GFID_wall: (a1) frozen A16_N replays the 18 sealed 045 A16_N traces (self-replay); (a2) API16 replays the 18 sealed 046 A16_N fresh records; (a3) API16D replays the 18 sealed 045 and 18 sealed 046 A16_N traces. Each difference is put in one class. 'cap-timing': same words and model, only the capped counts and the label differ, with a capped call on at least one side. 'word-divergence': the words differ after a capped call. 'infidelity': any difference with no capped call on either side
parts.b_determinism: 18 fresh cases (12 scale16, 6 control) run by API16D and API16D_b
parts.c_fresh: the same 18 fresh cases run by A16_N once (reference arm). The API16D records are those from part b
parts.d_scale20: 12 fresh scale20 worlds, API16D only, run once
